semantic.justification: Actual InputSource Reference/OUString aggregate ownership, cached XLocator SDK, generated SAXException and FastLocatorImpl component now admit genuine XInputStream bytes through XMLFile2UTFConverter. Source copies and ParserData snapshots precede document callbacks; 16KiB reads stop at EOF without closing input. The existing saxes backend receives incrementally decoded UTF8/UTF16/UTF32 or actual RTL legacy-descriptor output without DOM. This backend binding is not a port or certification of native libxml2 encoding aliases, diagnostics or locator positions. Host FastSaxParseError remains an explicit host envelope; only the missing-input SAXException is an actual generated UNO exception. Native parser mutex/thread machinery, complete XFastParser service, unported RTL encodings, allocation unwind/ABI and full package/model/filter/DOCX/XLSX/Worker/UI acceptance remain unverified. Existing file/autosave/recovery behavior is preserved.
